title: CLO2024.1 New Feature Dispatch: New features launched, turning your creative ideas into reality!
description:
CLO2024.1 new features are now online!  
This update introduces new features: AI Model Workshop, automatic generation of PBR textures, texture effect presets, as well as updates to the virtual model editor, optimization of the color matching editor, and upgrades to the automatic recognition module!  
Click the video to explore the new version with CLO technical experts!  

For detailed videos on previous versions, please visit: https://space.bilibili.com/477753185/channel/seriesdetail?sid=864877&ctype=0
